decisions.reason: As a recently launched bread close to the core bakery range in a growing market, Product A would likely be kept because the firm has already committed production and website visibility to it and there is no clear evidence of failure that would overcome escalation of commitment.

Product B would likely be kept because the guided historic mill tour is highly visible, fits the firm's heritage-and-experience positioning, and management can readily interpret any early uncertainty as temporary while justifying its public commitment.

As a sweet pastry closely aligned with established confectionery capabilities and publicly presented on the website, Product C would likely be kept since sunk effort and the absence of clear disappointing results favor continuing it.
